title: Paraguay gave France 90 minutes of hell — then Mbappé broke the wall

scenes.voiceover: Paraguay just gave France ninety minutes of absolute hell — and it took one moment from one man to break the wall.
Seventy-six percent possession for France. A five-four-one wall from Paraguay. And keeper Orlando Gill made save after save — even denying Mbappé twice in stoppage time.
Then the seventieth minute: Gómez brings down Doué, and Mbappé buries the penalty. His seventh goal of the tournament — level with Messi in the Golden Boot race — and his nineteenth World Cup goal.
So the quarterfinal is set: France against Morocco, July ninth — a rematch of the 2022 semifinal. Full bracket breakdown on the channel, and tell me: can the Atlas Lions get revenge?
